newsitem.title: USA: Wholesome & Hearty says Q4 likely below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Wholesome & Hearty says Q4 likely below estimates.

text.p: Wholesome & Hearty Foods Inc said fourth quarter earnings are also likely to fall short of analysts' estimates.
It said it expects to report fourth quarter sales of about $8 million, up about three percent over the year-ago fourth quarter, but below analysts' estimates.
It said the lower growth rate was due to a normal seasonal downturn that occurs in the fourth quarter, along with a slower rate of growth in its food service business.
Analysts' mean estimate is for fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.03, according to First Call.
Earnings are due to be reported on February 11.
The company, which sells meatless and lowfat food products, said it expects to be in 80 percent of U.S. retail grocery stores by the end of April 1997.

"The commensurate increase in retail sales volumes should show strong and accelerating volume gains each quarter versus the same quarters in 1996," chief executive officer Lyle Hubbard said in a statement.
The company earned $0.03 per share in the year ago fourth quarter.
